question: What liberation from all punishments follows recitation up to a crore?
premises: The practitioner should recite up to a crore.
The agent is a mantra practitioner.
Release from all punishments is stated.
inference: A mantra practitioner who recites up to a crore times is freed from all punishments.
plain_english: A mantra practitioner who recites up to a crore is released from all punishments.
